text:
Fraser Minten has 6 goals in 17 games as a 22-year-old center in his second Boston season, and that is a nice return on a player the Bruins got from Toronto. He is playing 16:30 a night. Our numbers say the scoring is a mix of skill and good fortune.

His own finishing is a little hot (6 goals on 4.13 expected). The bigger factor is around him: Boston has scored 8.81 more goals than its chances deserve with Minten on the ice, a bigger gap than any of his Bruins teammates we've written up, and at 5v5 the team is a touch worse with him than without him. That on-ice luck is what fades first.

The skill piece worth watching is his zone entries. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking has him carrying the puck in on 60 percent of them last season. He was picked 38th in 2022 and has already played 107 NHL games. Our range has him around 22 goals. That's a real player. Just expect his line's numbers to cool in the next few weeks.
headline: Minten is finishing, and Boston's luck is helping
